extracted.name: Universal biscuit dough
extracted.description: Use this recipe to make our raspberry dodgers, vanilla spirals, checkerboard and ginger biscuits. Box up your biscuits into a festive box to gift to friends
ingredient_lines: 400g plain flour plus extra for dusting
instruction_lines: Put the butter in a bowl and beat using electric beaters until soft and creamy. Beat in the sugar, then the egg and vanilla, and finally the flour. If the dough feels sticky, add a little more flour and knead it in. Bring together into a ball and use to make our raspberry dodgers, vanilla spirals, checkerboard and ginger biscuits.
